description: A two-member team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, working together to explore a challenge and create a project.
summary: The Silent Explorers is an educational digital storybook that explores three historic pieces of NASA space exploration hardware: the Apollo Lunar Module, Surveyor 1, and Sojourner. Through simple storytelling, it introduces young space enthusiasts to these spacecraft, their missions, and the scientific contributions they made to lunar and Martian exploration. The project highlights how these machines continue to be part of the history of space exploration even after their missions ended.
details:
The Silent Explorers is an educational digital storybook about three historic pieces of NASA space exploration hardware: the Apollo Lunar Module, Surveyor 1, and Sojourner.

The project presents the history, purpose, and contributions of these spacecraft through simple storytelling and visual content. It is designed to help school-age students learn about past space missions and understand how these machines contributed to lunar and Martian exploration.

The project was created using Canva for designing the digital storybook and presentation. ChatGPT was used for research assistance, organizing information, and writing support.

Our creative approach was to turn the history of abandoned space hardware into an accessible storytelling experience. We focused on clear explanations, educational value, and the lasting legacy of each mission.
